Environmental Ed Day 8 How Does Your Garden Grow

Oct 13, 2010 • Janice Cotcher

On my way to school this morning, I decided I needed to be a more proactive and less frozen in fear about starting to eat more locally. I cannot start a garden this time of year but I can certainly plan for one. Next weekend for our class camping trip I am going to take the book Carrots Love Tomatoes. Hopefully we will get some down time so I can read it and start planning my future garden.

In the meantime, I’m going to start growing a little indoor garden. I went to Home Depot to get seeds and planting supplies and there was not many options. I bought seeds for Summer Savory, Thai Basil, Chervil and Sage. I really wanted mint but there was none :( I was a little disappointed in the selection but realize that seeds are not in great demand this time of year. I got the bright idea to buy some peppers to harvest the seeds to grow my own. I plan to either pickle or dehydrate the peppers after I have the seeds. It is a small start but a least I’m heading in the right direction.
